data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 7.2m (2018: GBP 68.9m) is an improvement of GBP 1.0m (2018: deterioration of GBP 3.3m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to favourable developments on Property, Aviation and Marine classes with partially offsetting unfavourable developments across the other classes.
data.standardized_narrative: For 2019, Syndicate 1206 reported a net prior year reserve release of GBP 1.0 million, representing a 0.31% release of its opening gross claims outstanding. This favourable development was primarily driven by the Property, Aviation, and Marine classes, with some offsetting unfavourable developments in other classes. The syndicate ceased underwriting with effect from 1 January 2018, and the report reflects a run-off scenario. No specific named events were identified as causes for the prior year development. Gross premiums written for the year were negative GBP 1.375 million, reflecting a reduction in business.
raw_causal_phrases: favourable developments on Property, Aviation and Marine classes with partially offsetting unfavourable developments across the other classes
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure is net of reinsurance as no gross figure was explicitly stated or derivable from a claims development triangle.
